strings.live.stream.busy: The stream is starting or ending. Please wait until it finishes.
strings.live.stream.no-key: Register the stream key under Streaming on the Settings screen.
strings.live.stream.confirm-start.title: Go live?
strings.live.stream.confirm-start.body: Depending on your YouTube settings, it may go public immediately.
strings.live.voice-lab-busy.title: Voice Lab is making a voice
strings.live.voice-lab-busy.stream-body: Going live now cancels making the voice.
strings.live.voice-lab-busy.record-body: Recording now cancels making the voice.
strings.live.stream.confirm-stop.title: End the stream?
strings.live.stream.slow: The connection speed cannot keep up. Lower the bitrate in the settings.
strings.live.stream.problem.no-key: No stream key is registered. Register it under Streaming on the Settings screen.
strings.live.stream.problem.unreachable: The server cannot be reached. Check the internet connection and the URL.
strings.live.stream.problem.rejected: The stream was refused. Check the stream key in YouTube Studio.
strings.live.stream.problem.lost: The connection was lost. Reconnecting automatically. Recording goes on.
strings.live.stream.problem.encoder: The encoder cannot be used. Try again, or check the log on the Diagnostics screen.
strings.setup.streaming.title: Streaming
strings.setup.streaming.url.description: YouTube works with the default. The URL starts with rtmp:// or rtmps://.
strings.setup.streaming.url.invalid: Enter a URL that starts with rtmp:// or rtmps://.
strings.setup.streaming.url.unencrypted: rtmp:// is not encrypted, and neither is the stream key sent over it. rtmps:// is recommended.
strings.setup.streaming.key.dialog.title: Register the stream key
strings.setup.streaming.key.dialog.body: Enter the stream key from YouTube Studio.
strings.setup.streaming.key.failed: It could not be registered. Please try again.
strings.setup.streaming.key.remove.title: Remove the stream key?
strings.setup.streaming.key.remove.body: You will need to register it again to stream.
strings.setup.streaming.codec.description: AV1 is recommended: it looks better at the same bitrate. If the stream does not work properly, choose H.264.
strings.setup.streaming.codec.no-av1: This PC's GPU or the destination does not support AV1, so the stream uses H.264.
strings.setup.streaming.bitrate.description: 6 Mbps is recommended for 1080p at 30 fps. Keep it below your connection's upload speed.
strings.setup.streaming.test.description: Checks that the server can be reached. The stream does not start.
strings.common.candidate.name: Candidate {n}
strings.lab.not-set-up.title: Not ready to make voices yet
strings.lab.not-set-up.body: Making voices is not available here.
strings.lab.live-lock.title: Not available while streaming or recording
strings.lab.live-lock.body: It can be used once streaming and recording end.
strings.lab.setup.title: Preparing to make voices
strings.lab.setup.lead: This sets up what making voices needs on this PC. Streaming, and converting your voice with registered voices, do not need it.
strings.lab.setup.gpu.help: An NVIDIA GPU (GeForce GTX 900 series or later) is required. Voices are made on the GPU.
strings.lab.setup.gpu.missing: No NVIDIA GPU was found. Making voices requires an NVIDIA GPU.
strings.lab.setup.gpu.old: This GPU is not supported. A GeForce GTX 900 series or later GPU is required.
strings.lab.setup.driver.help: The NVIDIA driver must be version 528.33 or later.
strings.lab.setup.driver.old: Update the NVIDIA driver to version 528.33 or later.
strings.lab.setup.location.help: About 13 GB is used once built. While building, up to about 30 GB of free space is needed. A "VirtualVesselStudio" folder is created in the chosen folder.
strings.lab.setup.location.low: Not enough free space. Choose a folder with at least 30 GB free.
strings.lab.setup.location.pick-title: Choose a folder for the voice-making environment
strings.lab.setup.online.help: Components are downloaded from GitHub, Hugging Face, PyPI, and others. The terms list every source.
strings.lab.setup.online.problem: Connect to the internet, then open this again.
strings.lab.setup.agree-note: Preparing requires agreeing to Voice Lab's terms of use.
strings.lab.setup.time-note: Building the environment takes about 30 to 60 minutes. If stopped, it continues where it left off.
strings.lab.setup.terms.title: Terms and disclaimer
strings.lab.setup.terms.missing: The terms could not be read. Reinstall the app.
strings.lab.setup.agree: I have read and agree to the terms and disclaimer
strings.lab.setup.live-note: Paused for streaming or recording. Press Continue once they end.
strings.lab.setup.running-note: If the app is closed, it can continue the next time it opens.
strings.lab.setup.failed.network.title: Components could not be downloaded
strings.lab.setup.failed.network.body: Check the internet connection, then continue.
strings.lab.setup.failed.corrupt.title: A downloaded component was damaged
strings.lab.setup.failed.corrupt.body: Continue to download it again. If this keeps happening, check the log on the Diagnostics screen.
strings.lab.setup.failed.disk.title: Not enough free space
strings.lab.setup.failed.disk.body: Free up space at the location, then continue.
strings.lab.setup.failed.setup.title: The environment could not be built
strings.lab.setup.failed.setup.body: Continue to try again. If this keeps happening, check the log on the Diagnostics screen.
strings.lab.setup.failed.check.title: No voice could be made in the check
strings.lab.setup.failed.check.body: Update the NVIDIA driver, then continue. If this keeps happening, check the log on the Diagnostics screen.
strings.lab.setup.done.title: Ready to make voices
strings.lab.setup.done.body: The voice made in the check was not kept.
strings.lab.setup.update.title: An update for making voices is available
strings.lab.setup.update.body: Voices can still be made with the current environment while it updates.
strings.lab.setup.log.packages: Building: installing the packages (takes a few minutes)
strings.lab.setup.log.finish: Finishing: removing files no longer needed
strings.lab.base.lead: Set the direction of the voice. The same words (prompt) give a different voice each time, by chance, so listen, compare, and choose the one you like.
strings.lab.base.samples-missing: There are no samples for the words. Make them to hear how each example and word differs (making them takes a few minutes).
strings.lab.base.samples-partial: Some words have no sample yet. Make the samples to compare those words too (samples already made are kept).
strings.lab.base.sample-not-made: Make the samples to hear this
strings.lab.base.examples-note: Play one with ▶. Picking one puts its words on the shelf below.
strings.lab.base.shelf-note: The ▶ beside a word plays a sample with only that word changed.
strings.lab.base.ask: The prompt used to make the voice
strings.lab.base.prompt-note: Up to 500 characters. Brackets, line breaks, and invisible characters are removed. Do not ask it to imitate a real person's voice.
strings.lab.base.words-note: Up to 200 characters. Brackets, line breaks, and invisible characters are removed. Do not ask it to imitate a real person's voice.
strings.lab.resume.work.title: Unfinished voice
strings.lab.resume.work.body: Stopped at {step} (kept {time}). Making new candidates replaces it.
strings.lab.resume.discard.title: Discard the unfinished voice?
strings.lab.resume.discard.body: The candidates picked and the timbre adjusted are lost. This cannot be undone.
strings.lab.resume.voice.title: A voice not registered yet
strings.lab.resume.voice.body: Made {time}. Try it with your own voice and register it if you like it.
strings.lab.base.line-note: The line the candidates read so you can compare them. It has nothing to do with voice conversion itself. A longer line takes longer to make the candidates. Up to 200 characters; brackets and line breaks are removed.
strings.lab.base.seed-note: The seed the next candidates start at. It moves on by the number made each time. The same prompt, line, and seed make the same candidates again.
strings.lab.base.words-hint: For example: a soft, gentle way of speaking
strings.lab.base.make-note: Making takes about 10 seconds per voice. The first round takes a little longer to get ready.
strings.lab.base.count.tip: Fewer is quicker to try; six is better for comparing
strings.lab.base.near.tip: Makes candidates that differ a little from the voice you picked
strings.lab.base.candidates-note: If none fits, change the words or add candidates.
strings.lab.base.failed: The candidates could not be made. Try again
strings.lab.timbre.lead: Adjust the chosen voice's timbre and listen right away. Intonation and speed follow how you speak.
strings.lab.timbre.title: Timbre
strings.lab.timbre.pitch.tip: Moves the basic pitch of the voice in semitones
strings.lab.timbre.age.tip: Makes the resonance sound older or younger
strings.lab.timbre.brightness.tip: How strong the high resonance (2 to 5 kHz) is
strings.lab.timbre.softness.tip: Strengthens the lowest part of the voice and takes the edge off the highs
strings.lab.timbre.mechanical-body: Moving pitch, age, and brightness all far tends to sound unnatural. Keeping one of them small is recommended.
strings.lab.timbre.breathiness.tip: How much breath is in the voice
strings.lab.timbre.hold.tip: Keep this timbre to compare or go back to later
strings.lab.timbre.held-note: Held timbres (cleared when you pick another base)
strings.lab.timbre.far: It may sound like another person
strings.lab.timbre.far-body: A large age change alters who the voice sounds like. Compare and check.
strings.lab.timbre.note: When it is right, make the voice. You can make it again at any time.
strings.lab.timbre.failed: The shaped voice could not be made
strings.lab.build.lead: Makes a voice model from the chosen voice. Other screens can be used meanwhile.
strings.lab.build.note: It takes about 20 minutes per voice (on an RTX 4070).
strings.lab.build.note.normal: It takes about 30 minutes per voice (on an RTX 4070).
strings.lab.build.note.long: It takes about 50 minutes per voice (on an RTX 4070).
strings.lab.build.length.description: More learns more of the voice's softness and roundness, and takes longer.
strings.lab.build.note.test: For checking the screens in the Editor: 4 lines of training speech and 1 epoch. It takes minutes, and the voice is not one to use.
strings.lab.build.failed: The voice could not be made. Try again
strings.lab.build.out-of-memory: Not enough GPU memory. Close other applications and try again
strings.lab.try.lead: Convert your own voice with the voice made, and check it as the stream would sound.
strings.lab.try.failed: Could not convert. Check the file
strings.lab.try.hear-off-body: Turn Hear on to hear the converted voice.
strings.lab.try.mic-on: Converting. Speak to hear the converted voice.
strings.lab.register.back: STEP 4 Try it with your voice
strings.lab.register.title: Register
strings.lab.register.name: Voice name
strings.lab.register.note: What it was made from is kept, so it can be made again later.
strings.lab.register.use-now: Use it for the stream once registered
strings.lab.register.done-used: Registered and set as the voice for the stream
strings.frame.layers.tip: Click to select; drag up or down to change the stacking order. Ctrl+Up and Ctrl+Down also move it
strings.frame.mode.tip: Place: drag to move, and drag corners or edges to resize. Crop: drag edges to cut the video
strings.frame.flip.tip: Mirrors the video left to right
strings.frame.allow-outside.tip: Lets the video move beyond the stream screen
strings.frame.crop-mode.tip: Drag the edges to cut the video
strings.frame.reset-crop.tip: Stops cropping and zooming, and shows the whole video
strings.frame.fit.tip: Makes the video as large as fits on the stream screen, keeping its aspect ratio
strings.frame.fill.tip: Makes the video cover the stream screen, keeping its aspect ratio
strings.frame.center.tip: Moves the video to the center of the stream screen without resizing it
strings.frame.forward.tip: Swaps places with the video just in front
strings.frame.backward.tip: Swaps places with the video just behind
strings.frame.front.tip: Shows the video in front of the others
strings.frame.back.tip: Shows the video behind the others
strings.error.unexpected: Something went wrong and the action could not be completed. Please try again.
strings.preview.label: Stream preview
strings.preview.frame-rate.tip: Stream frame rate. Below the set rate the video looks choppy
strings.preview.exit-fullscreen: Leaves full screen and returns to the normal view
strings.preview.fullscreen-hint: Press Esc or F to return
strings.notice.failure.title: Couldn't complete the action
strings.startup.data-root.title: Can't use the data folder
strings.startup.data-root.body: Virtual Vessel Studio can't write to the data folder. Check the folder location and free space, then start again.
strings.startup.failed.title: Virtual Vessel Studio couldn't start
strings.startup.failed.body: Start it again. If this keeps happening, report it with the logs.
strings.settings.recovered.title: Couldn't read the settings file
strings.settings.recovered.body: Started with the default settings. The original file is kept in the same folder.
strings.settings.save-failed.title: Couldn't save the settings
strings.settings.save-failed.body: Your changes apply until you quit. Check that the settings folder can be written to.
strings.quit.title: Quit the application?
strings.quit.body.streaming: You are streaming. Quitting also ends the stream.
strings.quit.body.recording: You are recording. The recording is saved before the application closes.
strings.quit.body.streaming-recording: You are streaming and recording. The stream ends and the recording is saved before the application closes.
strings.tip.nav.setup: Set up devices and avatars, change app settings, and see the credits of the software in use
strings.tip.nav.diagnostics: Inspect how things are running (for developers)
strings.screen.placeholder: This screen is on its way
strings.settings.title: App settings
strings.settings.motion.description: Stops movement and blinking on screen. With Match Windows settings, they stop when Animation effects is off in Windows.
strings.diagnostics.detailed-off: Detailed metrics: off. Times and values are not recorded
strings.diagnostics.column.name: Name
strings.diagnostics.skeleton.title: Skeleton comparison
strings.diagnostics.skeleton.legend: Solid: what tracking observed. Wide dashes: the avatar, drawn from the tracked shoulders along the avatar's bones with the tracked lengths. They overlap where the directions match. Shown on the avatar's sides, following the mirroring setting.
strings.diagnostics.skeleton.side: Side (from the avatar's right; front to the right)
strings.diagnostics.skeleton.camera.note: While the face's place is not known, the whole image is covered. The image never goes to the stream or a recording.
strings.diagnostics.skeleton.no-body: No body is tracked. Start tracking or replay a recording.
strings.diagnostics.skeleton.left.elevation: Left upper arm, raised above level
strings.diagnostics.skeleton.left.forward: Left upper arm, turned forward from the side
strings.diagnostics.skeleton.right.elevation: Right upper arm, raised above level
strings.diagnostics.skeleton.right.forward: Right upper arm, turned forward from the side
strings.setup.voice.title: Voice conversion
strings.setup.voice.no-voice.body: Make a voice in Voice Lab to choose the voice to convert to.
strings.setup.voice.no-gpu: Voice conversion cannot be used on this PC
strings.setup.voice.no-gpu.body: It needs a GPU, and no usable GPU was found.
strings.setup.voice.failed.body: The stream and recordings get your own voice. Turn it on again; if it keeps happening, check the log on the Diagnostics screen.
strings.setup.voice.enabled.body: Off, your own voice goes to the stream and recordings. It starts as it was last time.
strings.setup.voice.voice.body: Choose from the voices made in Voice Lab.
strings.setup.voice.auto-pitch.body: Measures your voice and moves it to the chosen voice's pitch.
strings.setup.voice.adjust.body-auto: In semitones, added to the automatic match.
strings.setup.voice.adjust.body-manual: In semitones. From a man's voice to a woman's, about +12.
strings.diagnostics.voice.title: Voice conversion (prototype)
strings.diagnostics.voice.file-unreadable: This audio file cannot be read
strings.diagnostics.voice.state.playing-file: Converting the audio file. It also goes to streams and recordings
strings.diagnostics.voice.state.no-microphone: No sound from the microphone. Choose one under Audio in Setup
strings.diagnostics.voice.state.unavailable: The models or the microphone are missing
strings.diagnostics.voice.unusable: A voice this version cannot use
strings.diagnostics.voice.switching: Getting the chosen voice ready; the last voice converts until then
strings.diagnostics.recordings.title: Tracking recordings
strings.diagnostics.recordings.start.during-repl: Recording is not possible during replay
strings.diagnostics.recordings.delete.title: Delete this recording?
strings.diagnostics.recordings.delete.body: A deleted recording cannot be brought back.
strings.diagnostics.recordings.delete-all.title: Delete all recordings?
strings.diagnostics.recordings.delete-all.body: Every recording except one being recorded or replayed is deleted. This cannot be undone.
strings.diagnostics.recordings.note: Recordings hold only numbers, no video. They never leave this PC.
strings.diagnostics.recordings.failed: A recording operation failed. Check the log.
strings.tip.nav.gallery: Check how the shared parts look and work (for developers)
strings.gallery.note: These are samples: using them changes no setting or state
strings.gallery.disabled-reason: Connect a camera to use this
strings.gallery.tooltip-note: Shows after about half a second, and when chosen with the keyboard. It says briefly what a control does, with its shortcut, and why a disabled button can't be used
strings.tip.gallery.sample: Says briefly what a control does
strings.tip.gallery.mic: Turn the microphone on or off
strings.gallery.title: Stream title
strings.gallery.noise-help: The icon after a name holds the item's explanation, so the screen stays short and those who want it can read it
strings.gallery.notice-body: It is here to check how notices look
strings.gallery.dialog-body: This is a sample; nothing changes
strings.live.hint: Drag a video to move it and drag its corners to resize it. Right-click for more.
strings.live.record.busy: Recording is starting or stopping. Please wait until it finishes.
strings.live.record.confirm.title: Stop recording?
strings.live.record.confirm.body: What has been recorded so far is saved.
strings.live.record.problem.folder: The recording folder cannot be written. Choose another folder under Recording on the Settings screen.
strings.live.record.problem.disk: There is not enough free space to record (or the recording was stopped). Delete files you do not need, or choose a folder on another drive under Recording on the Settings screen.
strings.live.record.problem.encoder: The video could not be written. Record again; if it keeps happening, check the log on the Diagnostics screen.
strings.setup.capture.game.title: Capture (game screen)
strings.setup.capture.subscreen.title: Capture (sub monitor)
strings.setup.capture.audio.description: The device the game's sound comes from. Choosing a video device chooses its audio too.
strings.setup.capture.problem.choose: Choose the capture board under Device. A camera is never opened by itself, so a webcam does not show you by mistake.
strings.setup.capture.problem.signal: No video is arriving. Check the game device's power and cable connection.
strings.setup.capture.problem.notfound: Connect the device and it is found again automatically.
strings.setup.capture.problem.failed: Another app may be using the device.
strings.setup.capture.problem.inuse: Tracking uses this camera. Choose another device.
strings.setup.tracking.title: Tracking
strings.setup.tracking.problem.choose: Choose the webcam to track with in Camera.
strings.setup.tracking.problem.notfound: The camera is not found. Connect it and it is found again automatically.
strings.setup.tracking.problem.inuse: The game screen capture uses this camera. Choose another camera.
strings.setup.tracking.problem.failed: The camera could not open or tracking could not start. Check that no other app is using the camera.
strings.setup.tracking.problem.noperson: Sit in front of the camera so your face and upper body are in view.
strings.setup.recording.title: Recording
strings.setup.recording.folder.description: Where recordings are saved. Used from the next recording.
strings.setup.recording.quality.description: Standard is 6 Mbps and High 12 Mbps. High looks better, and its files are about twice as large.
strings.setup.recording.codec.description: AV1 is recommended: smaller files at the same quality. Choose H.264 if an older editor or phone cannot open the files.
strings.setup.recording.codec.no-av1: This PC's GPU does not support AV1, so recordings use H.264.
strings.setup.audio.title: Audio
strings.setup.audio.problem.not-found: The device is not connected. It is used again as soon as it is connected.
strings.setup.audio.problem.in-use: Another application is using this device exclusively. Close it, or turn off exclusive use in its settings.
strings.setup.audio.problem.access-denied: Windows does not allow access to the microphone. Open the microphone privacy settings and allow desktop apps to access it.
strings.setup.audio.problem.failed: The device could not be opened. Choose it again; if it keeps happening, check the log on the Diagnostics screen.
strings.setup.audio.monitored.description: Plays the source on the monitor output, without changing the stream or recordings. Headphones are recommended: speakers leak into the microphone.
strings.setup.audio.denoise.description: Reduces keyboard, mouse, and other sounds while you are not speaking, with or without voice conversion.
strings.setup.audio.game-device: The game audio's device is chosen on the Video page.
strings.setup.audio.delay.description: The avatar moves later than your voice, since its motion is read from the camera. Streaming and recording get the sound this much later to match. What you hear is not delayed.
strings.setup.avatar.title: Avatar
strings.setup.avatar.filetitle: Choose the avatar file to register
strings.setup.avatar.problem.notvrm: This is not a VRM file. Choose a file ending in .vrm.
strings.setup.avatar.problem.toolarge: The file is too large. Choose a file of 1 GB or less.
strings.setup.avatar.problem.missingbones: This model cannot be used because its humanoid bones are incomplete.
strings.setup.avatar.problem.loadfailed: The avatar could not be loaded. Check that the file is not damaged.
strings.setup.avatar.problem.storage: Could not save. Check the free space at the save location.
strings.setup.avatar.confirm.title: Register this avatar?
strings.setup.avatar.confirm.body: Check the terms of use set by the author before registering.
strings.setup.avatar.confirm.notice: This model is not set to be usable as an avatar by everyone. Check the terms of use to see whether you may use it.
strings.setup.avatar.remove.title: Unregister this avatar?
strings.setup.avatar.remove.body: The copy of the model in this app is deleted. Your original file is kept.
strings.setup.avatar.license.title: Terms of use (set by the model's author)
strings.setup.avatar.license.name: Model name
strings.setup.avatar.license.permission: Who may use it as an avatar
strings.setup.avatar.value.modificationredistrib: Allowed, including redistributing what you changed
strings.setup.credits.title: Credits and licenses: the app
strings.setup.credits.intro: Virtual Vessel Studio uses the following software and assets. Where the full license text is included, open it with "Show full text".
strings.setup.credits.on-demand.title: Credits and licenses: Voice Lab's Python environment
strings.setup.credits.on-demand.intro: When the training environment for making voices in Voice Lab is set up, the following software and models are installed on this PC. They are not part of the app, so each one's full license text is published by its provider.
strings.setup.credits.unavailable: The credits could not be read. Try restarting the app.
strings.setup.credits.missing: The full license text is missing.
strings.setup.tracking.depth.description: 2D leaves out moving toward and away from the camera and moves the avatar only as seen from the front. The arms point more steadily.
strings.setup.tracking.speed.description: Higher follows your movement faster; lower keeps the avatar steadier.
strings.setup.tracking.range.description: For streaming seated. Full body is coming later.
strings.setup.tracking.parts.description: Turning off parts you do not use lowers the load. A part turned off does not move.
strings.setup.tracking.model.description: Light uses less of the computer but tracks the body more roughly. A change takes a few seconds to get ready again.
strings.setup.face.title: Face and finger tuning
strings.setup.face.intro: With tracking running, watch the avatar's movement while you adjust. Higher values show an expression with less movement. Under each slider is how far the avatar moves now.
strings.setup.face.fingers.description: Raise these if the fingers do not bend far enough, and lower them if they bend too far. An open hand stays open at any value.
strings.setup.face.light.description: This also changes the light on the stream, and is saved.
strings.setup.face.winks.description: When on, one eye can close alone. Turn it off if one eye closes by mistake, such as when you turn your head.
strings.voice.tone.title: Finish
strings.voice.tone.note: Shapes how the converted voice sounds. The voice itself does not change. The stream gets the same finish.
strings.lab.terms-tab.title: Voice Lab terms of use
strings.lab.library.lead: The voices you made and the records of making them. Listen, rename, write notes, delete, or make one again.
strings.lab.library.empty: No voice has been made yet. Make one in the Make a voice tab.
strings.lab.library.storage.samples.help: The audio STEP 1 plays for each example and word. Once deleted, Make the samples makes them again (it takes a few minutes).
strings.lab.library.storage.candidates.help: Voice candidates and preview audio made earlier. Candidates a record was built from, and those of the session open now, are not deleted.
strings.lab.library.delete-samples.body: The samples are deleted. Make the samples makes them again (it takes a few minutes).
strings.lab.library.delete-candidates.body: Voice candidates and preview audio made earlier are deleted. Candidates a record was built from stay.
strings.lab.library.storage.environment.help: The Python environment and models used for voice candidates, samples, and training. Streaming does not use it, so deleting it does not affect streaming with registered voices.
strings.lab.library.storage.environment.external: It was not built by the app, so it cannot be deleted here
strings.lab.library.delete-environment.body: The Python environment and models are deleted. Making voices needs the environment built again. Streaming with registered voices is not affected.
strings.lab.library.delete-voice.body: The voice is deleted. The record it was made from stays.
strings.lab.library.delete-run.body: The record and the training speech and weights made with it are deleted. Voices registered from it stay.
strings.lab.library.delete-making: It cannot be deleted while it is being made
strings.lab.library.delete-in-use: The voice in use for the stream cannot be deleted. Use another voice first
strings.lab.base.base-gone.body: The record's words are on the shelf. Make candidates and pick a base again.
strings.lab.crud.not-found: It was not found. It may have been deleted elsewhere.
strings.lab.crud.busy: Not while a voice is being made.
strings.lab.crud.storage-failed: Saving or deleting failed. Check the free space and the file permissions.
